description: This file implements a Supabase client wrapper class using REST and Auth endpoints, providing methods for user authentication, user management, and database operations such as select, insert, update, and delete. It also includes a factory function to instantiate the client with environment settings.

classes.name: SupabaseClient
classes.description: A minimal wrapper for Supabase REST and Auth endpoints, supporting user sign-up, sign-in, password update, and database operations.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] auth_sign_up(self, email: str, password: str, email_redirect_to: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password, optionally redirecting via email.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] auth_sign_in(self, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Signs in a user using email and password, returns authentication details.

methods.name: bool auth_update_user_password(self, email: str, new_password: str)
methods.description: Updates a user's password using the admin endpoint with service role key.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] select( self, table: str, select: str = "*", **filters )
methods.description: Fetches data from a specified table with optional filters.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] insert(self, table: str, rows: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Inserts new rows into a specified table.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] update(self, table: str, match_filters: Dict[str, Any], updates: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates existing rows in a specified table based on provided filters.

methods.name: bool delete(self, table: str, match_filters: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Deletes rows from a specified table based on filters.

methods.name: close(self)
methods.description: Closes the internal HTTPX asynchronous client.

methods.name: __init__(self, url: str, anon_key: str, service_role_key: str)
